_comment: ADD NEW ADVENTURERS HERE - Abilities modify the combat formula!

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.ability_desc: Sword and Warrior keywords count double for multiplier

mage.name: Mage
mage.ability_desc: Fire, Water, Steam, and Ice keywords count as matching. Mage keywords count double.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.ability_desc: Immune to Beast weakness. Ranger keywords count double.

monk.name: Monk
monk.ability_desc: Fist and Monk keywords count double for multiplier

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.ability_desc: Darkness, Assassin, Dagger, Poison, and Illusion keywords count as matching. Assassin keywords count double.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.ability_desc: Immune to Darkness weakness. Paladin keywords count double.

druid.name: Druid
druid.ability_desc: Nature, Beast, Plant, Earth, and Primal keywords count as matching. Healer keywords count double.

elementalist.name: Elementalist
elementalist.ability_desc: All element keywords get +1 multiplier bonus. Elemental keywords count double.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.ability_desc: Fist, Beast, Blood, Berserker, and Warrior keywords count as matching. Berserker keywords count double.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.ability_desc: Undead, Darkness, Necromancy, Spirit, and Demon keywords count as matching. Warlock keywords count double.

knight.name: Knight
knight.ability_desc: Immune to Sword weakness. Knight keywords count double.

archer.name: Archer
archer.ability_desc: Bow and Ranger keywords count double for multiplier

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.ability_desc: Construct, Metal, and Alchemy keywords count as matching. Engineer keywords count double.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.ability_desc: Occult and Warlock keywords count double for multiplier

bard.name: Bard
bard.ability_desc: Sonic, Instrument, Light, Enchantment, and Illusion keywords count as matching. Bard keywords count double.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.ability_desc: Assassin keywords count double for multiplier

time_mage.name: Time Mage
time_mage.ability_desc: Time, Arcane, Space, and Void keywords count as matching. Mage keywords count double.

dragon_rider.name: Dragon Rider
dragon_rider.ability_desc: Dragon, Fire, Ice, Thunder, Poison, and Wind keywords count as matching. Dragon keywords count double.

mech_pilot.name: Mech Pilot
mech_pilot.ability_desc: Construct, Metal, Steam, and Thunder keywords count as matching. Engineer keywords count double.

fey_knight.name: Fey Knight
fey_knight.ability_desc: Fey, Nature, Illusion, and Light keywords count as matching. Knight keywords count double.

sea_warden.name: Sea Warden
sea_warden.ability_desc: Aquatic, Water, Ice, and Wind keywords count as matching. Pirate keywords count double.
